conventions: metres, m/s, seconds, radians unless the key says otherwise; +x = right of centreline; +k = LEFT-hand turn; side is centreline-relative (which side of the road) EXCEPT scene()'s side, which is egocentric (which side of your nose — see its bearingDeg; its trackSide is the centreline side for cross-referencing); rival lateralM is relative to the player (+ = to your right)

hooks.name: atmosphere
hooks.summary: WHAT IS THE LIGHT DOING — day/night, sun or moon, floodlights, fog visibility, wet road. Raw values kept for measurement

hooks.name: awaitPresent
hooks.summary: WAIT FOR THE PIXELS — resolve once the next real frame has reached the screen; a screenshot tool taken before this resolves can read a stale or black canvas under HeadlessChrome

hooks.name: field
hooks.summary: THE GRID — race order, gap-to-leader and interval. world().rivals is the egocentric nearest-few

hooks.name: render
hooks.summary: SHOW IT — the one optional raster, APPROXIMATE. what: 'view'|'map'|'circuit'|'car'. For intuition, not measurement

hooks.name: scene
hooks.summary: WHAT IS AROUND ME — named scenery by distance and bearing; {visible:true} switches to the camera's on-screen list

hooks.name: world
hooks.summary: WHERE AM I — egocentric snapshot, the per-tick spine. detail brief|drive|full; `since` returns only what changed

hooks.name: describe
hooks.summary: EVERYTHING ABOUT ONE THING — 'prop:12' | 'corner:T3' | 'car:4' | 'span:2'. ids come back from scene()/query()/trackInfo()/field()

hooks.name: query
hooks.summary: A BOUNDED SLICE — filters compose; returns prototype + instances so repeated dressing costs one shape plus a position each. Narrow the filter rather than raising limit

hooks.name: carView
hooks.summary: WHAT AM I DRIVING — team, parts spec + effects, chassis silhouette, measured geometry; detail:"parts" adds per-part boxes

hooks.name: perf
hooks.summary: GOVERNOR SNAPSHOT — scale/fps/tier/autoTier/autoShed/userTier/strikes (alias of renderScale report)

hooks.name: spatialUpscale
hooks.summary: GLX + WGX + TLX SGSR1 (flag OFF by default). active only when on AND renderScale<~1; see UPSCALING-2026-09 §6–7

hooks.name: survey
hooks.summary: IS ANYTHING BROKEN — floating/buried props, props over the line, terrain through the road, holes and cliffs

hooks.name: trackInfo
hooks.summary: STATIC substrate — corners|sectors|profile|all. Fetch ONCE. Corners carry radius, apexSpeedKph, straightAfterM/exitsOntoStraight (no line), plus bankingDeg/camber,…

hooks.name: objective
hooks.summary: WHAT AM I TRYING TO DO — win condition, the trade-offs (track limits, ERS, overtake, parts budget), hard constraints. Static; read once

hooks.name: rollout
hooks.summary: drive an interval, return a digest instead of every frame

hooks.name: terminal
hooks.summary: {done, reason} — retired|finished|wrong_way|rescued|null

hooks.name: ego.clearLeftM/RightM
hooks.summary: metres to the barrier each side; small = no room to defend

hooks.name: ego.headingErrDeg
hooks.summary: + = nose right of the road; steer the opposite sign to null it

hooks.name: ego.lateralM
hooks.summary: + = right of centreline; the road runs out at halfWidthM

hooks.name: ego.onTrack
hooks.summary: false means you are on grass — grip is gone, straighten first

hooks.name: episodeId
hooks.summary: view-local episode counter; reset increments it and clears the delta baseline

hooks.name: nextCorner.apexSpeedKph
hooks.summary: roughly the fastest you can be at the apex and still hold it

hooks.name: nextCorner.exitsOntoStraight
hooks.summary: true = prioritise exit speed over entry speed here

hooks.name: nextCorner.status
hooks.summary: the braking call — BRAKE NOW means brake this instant

hooks.name: pacenotes
hooks.summary: the road ahead as a co-driver call: dir + severity 1-6 @ distance

hooks.name: rivals[].closingMps
hooks.summary: + = the gap is shrinking, whichever side they are on

hooks.name: rivals[].pace
hooks.summary: AI skill ~0.92-1.02; a slower car will not hold the position

hooks.name: session.seed
hooks.summary: replay this exact episode with reset(frac, speed, x, seed)

hooks.name: terminal.reason
hooks.summary: why the episode ended — retired vs finished vs wrong_way vs rescued

hooks.summary: read world()/scene()/trackInfo()/the read hooks to DECIDE; call render() only to SEE — its glyphs are approximate

hooks.name: lean default, pull detail
hooks.summary: the world is stored in FULL but never dumped — a flat serialisation is huge and reads worse. Keep the default lean and pull with describe(id)/query() where a decision needs it

hooks.name: per tick
hooks.summary: world({detail:"brief", since:<seq>}) — ~355 bytes/step, 34x cheaper than full. detail is the big lever

hooks.name: static vs dynamic
hooks.summary: trackInfo()+carView() are constant — fetch once. world()+field()+scene() are the live frame — read per decision
